description: Amendment to the National Environmental Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Through the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980, necessary legal provisions have been made for the protection, management of the environment of Sri Lanka and matters incidental thereto. It has been identified that the provisions of the said Act are inadequate in finding policy solutions to the legal and institutional issues that have arisen in relation to the environment at present and that the Act needs to be amended. Therefore, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-08-04 to amend the National Environmental Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to publish the National Environmental (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
